findings.summary: The Worker-side Build Log and asset-first WWW runtime carried separate embedded daily-entry lists, allowing the public history to lag src/buildLog.ts.
findings.resolution: Added a read-only /api/build-log endpoint backed by BUILD_LOG_ENTRIES and changed the asset-first runtime to load canonical completed entries from it, retaining an embedded fallback only for endpoint failure.
findings.d1_action: Stage this divergence/resolution as system research history; no live write path was available in this session.

findings.summary: TRY IT now has explicit Human + Turtle Terrarium entry modes and a provenance bridge that can write terraria_runs and terraria_events without copying raw dialogue.
intended_d1_objects: research_objects via migration-0007 triggers where applicable
findings.privacy_boundary: Raw human and Turtle text remains canonical in turtle_turns; Terrarium events carry pointers/context rather than duplicated raw dialogue.
findings.runtime_dependency: Requires the relevant Terraria tables to exist in the bound D1 database. Write failure is reported as not stored rather than silently asserted.
